newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday are expected to total $1.3 billion in 35 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.2 billion in 16 sales, with a $364 million N.Y.C. Municipal Assistance Corp. deal through Goldman, Sachs & Co. topping the list.
An additional 15 sales totaling $605 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
